newsitem.title: ESTONIA: ESTONIA - COMPENSATION FUND RAISES ITS ISSUE.
newsitem.headline: ESTONIA - COMPENSATION FUND RAISES ITS ISSUE.

text.p: Estonia's compensation fund (Huvitusfond) said on Monday it will raise its ninth issue from 30 to 46 million kroons because it has been oversubscribed.
Subscriptions have amounted to 49.7 million kroons, the fund said a statement.
The equilibrium price of an obligation was 316 EVP kroons (voucher kroons).
The fund will not meet subscriptions which fall below the equilibrium price. Up to 89 percent of the subscriptions for 316 EVP kroons will be met.
Some 13 percent of the issue goes to individuals and 87 percent to corporates, mostly banks. The largest investors were Hansapank, Tallinna Pank and Forekspank.
The fund's ninth issue raised 146 million EVP kroons from the market. Over the course of the nine issues, 1.2 billion EVP kroon have been invested in its obligations.
